news.title: Jaypee homebuyers’ complaints genuine, Suraksha Group breached resolution plan: Panel
news.para: An independent committee examining Jaypee Infratech homebuyers’ grievances has found most allegations of construction delays, poor quality, labour shortages and fund diversion to be genuine. The committee said Suraksha Group had failed to meet key resolution-plan obligations, including arranging Rs 3,000 crore in working capital, and urged urgent tribunal intervention.

news.title: Gurugram: Residents oppose DLF plan to install 24 DG sets near Moulsari Avenue metro station
news.para: In Gurgaon, residents of a local housing society are voicing strong objections to the installation of diesel generators in their vicinity. These installations, claimed to have been erected without proper environmental clearances, have sparked worries about pollution and safety risks. Developers argue that the generators do not necessitate specific approvals, yet residents raise concerns about their closeness to a metro corridor.

news.title: Over 39,800 rural families get pucca houses in Uttarakhand under PMAY-Gramin
news.para: Since 2022, a total of 39,815 rural families in Uttarakhand received pucca houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin. Udham Singh Nagar led with 4,882 houses built, followed closely by Haridwar and Rudraprayag with significant contributions. The state government has sought additional housing allocations from the Centre to continue supporting the initiative. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive direct financial assistance for effective housing construction.

news.title: HC bars Rohtak courts from hearing bail pleas in multi-crore real estate fraud case
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana high court has imposed restrictions on judicial officers in Rohtak regarding bail applications linked to a significant real estate fraud case involving Subhash Gupta and others. Criticism was directed at local police for allegedly protecting the accused, prompting the formation of a Special Investigation Team. Some arrests have already been made, with the next court hearing scheduled for October 28.

news.title: Motilal Oswal Alternates makes full exit from ₹1,155 crore realty fund
news.para: Motilal Oswal Alternates has successfully closed India Realty Excellence Fund IV after exiting all 37 investments. This fund, launched in 2020, generated a portfolio IRR of 20.4 percent despite sector challenges. The firm emphasised capital protection and active asset management throughout the investment period. Their focus has shifted towards structured credit as traditional funding sources remain selective. This marks a significant milestone for Motilal Oswal's real estate investment platform.

news.title: NCLAT seeks separate timeline commitments for completion of 16 stalled Supertech projects by November 6
news.para: NCLAT has ordered the Supreme Court committee to provide completion timelines for 16 Supertech housing projects. The new timelines for construction completion range between 12 to 36 months. The committee must submit a report with tentative completion dates by the next hearing on November 6. Supertech, currently under corporate insolvency resolution, is working with NBCC and facing funding challenges.

news.title: Embassy Developments'  sales bookings jump eight-fold to ₹3,225 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Embassy Developments Ltd has reported remarkable sales bookings of Rs 3,225 crore for Q2 of this fiscal year, showcasing an impressive eight-fold increase from Rs 409 crore during the same period last year. The pre-sales saw a rise from Rs 868 crore in the prior quarter, reflecting a robust demand for housing.

news.title: Sobha's sales bookings at ₹5,862 crore in H1 FY27
news.para: Sobha Ltd reported a significant rise in sales bookings during the first half of the fiscal year. The company's sales bookings reached Rs 5,862.4 crore, compared to Rs 3,981.4 crore last year. This increase reflects growing demand for housing in their market. In the second quarter, Sobha's bookings also rose by 16% from the previous year's figures.

news.title: Blackstone’s Siddharth Nawal set to take over as CEO of Nexus Select Trust
news.para: Siddharth Nawal will soon replace Dalip Sehgal as CEO of Nexus Select Trust in India. Nawal has worked with Blackstone in retail real estate for about ten years. Nexus Select Trust plans to expand its portfolio by acquiring more retail assets in India. The trust aims to grow its shopping center count from 19 to 30-35 malls by 2030.

news.title: Keystone Realtors' sales bookings up 84% at ₹1,423 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Keystone Realtors Ltd has enjoyed an impressive 84% boost in sales bookings during the second quarter of this fiscal year, reaching Rs 1,423 crore, up from Rs 772 crore last year. Additionally, sales volume increased by 31% to 0.65 million sq ft. With pre-sales hitting Rs 2,041 crore in the first half and a robust pipeline of launches, the company appears well-positioned for continued growth this fiscal year.

news.title: Farmers seek 10% developed plots, stage protest at Noida Authority office
news.para: Farmers from the Bhartiya Kisan Union (Manch) gathered outside the Noida Authority's office to voice their frustration over unmet demands. They are demanding the allocation of developed plots for lands that were acquired during prior development projects. Many farmers have not yet received these plots, and despite extra compensation, they allege that allocations remain unfulfilled due to a scarcity of available land.

news.title: Punjab CM gives property rights to houses built in Lal Lakir
news.para: Bhagwant Mann's recent announcement marks a significant step forward for families in Punjab by initiating the distribution of property ownership certificates. This measure, part of the Mera Ghar Mere Naam scheme, aims to formally recognize home ownership, especially in Lal Lakir, while enhancing property records across approximately 4,000 villages through innovative drone surveys and advanced mapping techniques.

news.title: Chandigarh administration demolishes 80 illegal structures in Manimajra
news.para: The Chandigarh Administration launched a demolition operation at Shastri Nagar, targeting unauthorized structures on agricultural land. Early in the morning, teams dismantled around 80 illegal buildings, reclaiming approximately 6 acres of occupied farmland near the local meat market. The collaboration of various departments ensured a safe and effective demolition process, reinforcing the administration's strict stance against illegal constructions throughout the city.

news.title: Institutional investments in Indian real estate rise 39% to $5.9 billion in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: From January to September 2026, Indian real estate attracted $5.9 billion in institutional investments, primarily driven by domestic players who invested $3.5 billion. The office sector alone secured $2.2 billion exclusively from local sources. Additionally, multi-city deals surged, contributing significantly to the overall investment landscape, showcasing a vibrant and diversified asset class dominance in the market.

news.title: Chandigarh administration finally takes up long-pending issues of housing societies
news.para: The Chandigarh administration has taken decisive steps to tackle the challenges faced by cooperative group housing societies. By withdrawing the controversial 1.2 factor, the administration aims to drastically cut conversion charges, a move that comes after nearly four years of negotiations and discussions. Residents have long pushed for the Estate Office to oversee the conversion process, and the administration is also making strides towards resolving unearned increase concerns.

news.title: Goa CZMA seeks removal of Carmona land from CRZ in CZMP maps
news.para: GCZMA has written to NCSCM to request the removal of certain land from CRZ classification. This request follows the hotel's claim that the land was mistakenly classified as khazan in CZMP. A site inspection found that only part of the land qualifies as khazan due to several factors. The inspection by WRD confirmed the absence of essential features that define khazan land.

news.title: GDA plans ‘Gurukul City’ in New Gorakhpur, project launch around Diwali
news.para: The Gorakhpur Development Authority has unveiled ambitious plans for the upcoming Gurukul City, which will span over 400 acres with an initial phase encompassing 100 acres. This residential project aims to cater to Gorakhpur's increasing housing needs as the city evolves into a booming urban hub. Situated conveniently near numerous educational and security institutions, construction is anticipated to kick off by Diwali, contingent on final approvals.

news.title: Centre approves ₹65 crore for geo-spacial based survey of unauthorised colonies
news.para: The Centre has greenlit a substantial project valued at Rs 65 crore under the DRISHTI initiative, aimed at granting property ownership rights to residents in unauthorized colonies of Delhi. This endeavor will employ a geographic information system survey for precise mapping and verification of property boundaries. Furthermore, to accelerate property registrations, PM-UDAY cells will be set up in 13 districts, significantly improving legal security for families in these areas.

news.title: Haryana RERA rejects Tata Primanti buyers’ claims after conveyance deed execution in Gurugram
news.para: In a recent ruling, the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority rejected a complaint against Tata Housing linked to its Sector 72 project. The buyers had executed the conveyance deed without any objections or reservations. The authority noted a lack of coercion or unfair practice in this case, highlighting that the occupation certificate was obtained before the buyers' allotment, which impacts the validity of post-deed claims.

news.title: SC seeks report on Chambal sand mining, calls impact on ecosystem ‘disastrous’
news.para: The Supreme Court has mandated the Central Empowered Committee to investigate the ramifications of riverbed sand mining, citing significant damage to river ecosystems and the risk to endangered species. States including Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh must provide affidavits confirming compliance with prior orders. This move aims to curb illegal sand mining activities and safeguard the National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary, with the next hearing scheduled for November 4.
